'''Camp Jacent''' was a military outpost maintained by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Jacent Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|lengthy battle]] for the world. It earned the nickname '''Ghost Town''' after every last inhabitant was massacred in the previous invasion.
